text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is an overview article describing the development, calibration, and validation of a national carbon and nitrogen accounting ecosystem model (FullCAM) for Australia’s greenhouse gas emissions reporting. It does not focus on land use/land cover (LULC) future prediction or simulation as a primary objective. Although it uses land cover change data (historic Landsat time-series) as inputs, it does not implement future LULC scenario modeling with mapped projections, quantitative accuracy metrics, or multiple future scenarios. The primary focus is on carbon and nitrogen cycling and greenhouse gas accounting rather than LULC prediction. It also lacks future LULC spatial projections or quantitative scenario comparisons, which are core inclusion criteria for research papers focused on LULC prediction.)
